title: Moonroof opening and unrelated halfway references
summary: This topic is mostly driven by one clear positive moonroof comment and several undetermined fragments that include similar wording but cover unrelated issues or open questions.

positive.summary: The positive review specifically praises the moonroof experience.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined fragments include a question about whether the moonroof should open further plus unrelated comments about charging stress and range drop, so the examples do not support a single clear sentiment theme.

limitations: The cluster mixes moonroof content with unrelated fragments linked by terms such as 'roughly' and 'halfway.'
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confident interpretation of customer sentiment about the moonroof itself.
Examples are insufficient to assess any consistent problem or benefit beyond one explicit positive moonroof comment and one question about opening distance.
